observed.detail: Olive-green full-width dual-cab locomotive; grey chamfered roof; cream side bands and V shaped nose stripe. Rectangular engine body parallel to rails.
Two front windscreens with wipers, one upper central headlamp, two lower lamps, buffers and central coupler.
Roof rectangular radiator at rear, two round central fans, low rectangular hatches. Side grille size changes along length.
Two three-axle bogies with complete sideframes, end crossmembers, axle boxes and coil springs. Exposed centre tank.
Supplementary reverse illustration supports same dual-cab paint and physical fittings; source workbook remains proportion authority.
